title_en: Two Generations, Two Views on Raising Kids
note_en: Notice 才 in 写完作业才能看手机 "only after finishing homework can you look at your phone." English uses "only after" or "not until," but Chinese puts the condition first and 才 right before the verb to show the action is allowed only once that condition is met. The same 才 appears in 两代人常常需要互相沟通，才能找到……教育方式 "the two generations need to talk before they can find an approach."
